defs.def: the fact that you have achieved sth that you want and have been trying to do or get; the fact of becoming rich or famous or of getting a high social position 成功；胜利；发财；成名

ex.s: Her success is just one example of increased time at home leading to an explosion in the houseplant industry.
ex.t: 她的成功只是居家时间增多导致室内植物产业爆发的一个例子。

ex.s: Will the golden word “success” form in their minds when they review our achievements?
ex.t: 当他们回顾我们的成就时，『成功』这个金光闪闪的词会在他们脑海中浮现吗？

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年超过四门AP课已是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: Ultimately, success came little by little.
ex.t: 最终，成功一点一点地到来了。

ex.s: Success knocks at your door only once.
ex.t: 成功只敲你一次门。

ex.s: Follow-up studies with the children later in life showed a connection between an ability to wait long enough to obtain a second treat and various forms of success.
ex.t: 后来对这些孩子进行的跟踪研究表明，能够耐心等待以获得第二份零食的能力与各种形式的成功之间存在关联。

ex.s: Hard work is the mother of success.
ex.t: 努力工作是成功之母。

ex.s: My adviser saw this experience as a groundbreaking success, emphasising the collaborating skills I acquired.
ex.t: 我的导师将这次经历视为开创性的成功，并强调我所获得的协作能力。

ex.s: > The adviser considered the author’s experience in the lab a groundbreaking success because publishable data had been produced.
ex.t: > 顾问认为，作者在实验室的经验是一次开创性的成功，因为已经产生了可公布的数据。

ex.s: Many instructors continue to teach using traditional lectures, which lead to lower success rates.
ex.t: 许多教师继续使用传统的讲授式教学，导致成功率较低。

ex.s: Most importantly, Edison realized that success depended on mass electrification, which he showed in New York City.
ex.t: 最重要的是，Edison意识到成功取决于大规模电气化，他在纽约市展示了这一点。

ex.s: That movie led him into the second half of his career where his comedic presence alone could make a movie a financial success even when movie reviewers would not rate it highly.
ex.t: 那部电影将他带入了职业生涯的下半场，在那个阶段，仅凭他的喜剧魅力就能让一部电影在商业上获得成功，即使影评人评价不高。

ex.s: "Success is success but that is all that it is," Dr Petroski writes.
ex.t: “成功就是成功，但仅此而已，”彼得罗斯基博士写道。

ex.s: Success results in overconfidence
ex.t: 失败应该避免。

ex.s: Success comes from joint efforts.
ex.t: 成功源于共同的努力。

ex.s: His unexpected success.
ex.t: 他意想不到的成功。

ex.s: His unexpected success.
ex.t: 他意想不到的成功。

ex.s: His unexpected success.
ex.t: 他意想不到的成功。

ex.s: For all of Bellevue’s success, adaptive signals are not a cure-all for jammed roadways.
ex.t: 尽管贝尔维尤取得了成功，自适应信号并非拥堵道路的万能药。

ex.s: What can we learn from Bellevue’s success?
ex.t: 从贝尔维尤的成功中我们能学到什么？

ex.s: Gaining success helps you become an expert.
ex.t: 获得成功有助于你成为专家。

ex.s: As CanCandy's success grows, so does Moore's credibility as a young entrepreneur.
ex.t: 随着Cancandy的成功，摩尔作为年轻企业家的信誉也与日俱增。

ex.s: Success means getting personal desires satisfied
ex.t: 成功意味着个人欲望得到满足

ex.s: What made Wang’s architectural design a success?
ex.t: 是什么让王澍的建筑设计取得成功？

ex.s: his success in publication
ex.t: 他在文学界的重要性

ex.s: A man owes his success to his family support.
ex.t: 一个男人把成功归功于家庭支持。

ex.s: Failure is the mother of success.
ex.t: 失败是成功之母。

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back — he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过纽曼自有食品和为重病儿童举办的"墙上的洞"夏令营，而我则通过圣丹斯电影节及其研究所和艺术节。

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back - he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过他的Newman's Own食品品牌和为重病儿童创办的Hole in the Wall夏令营来回报，而我则通过圣丹斯及其协会和电影节来回报。

ex.s: Their success.
ex.t: 他们的成功。

ex.s: Shopping centres have been organising events and activities to celebrate Chinese Spring Festival for years, while concerts and other performances are also proving a big success.
ex.t: 多年来，购物中心一直组织活动庆祝中国春节，而音乐会和其他演出也同样大获成功。

ex.s: Jaws was a great success, attracting huge audiences and winning many awards.
ex.t: 在任何情况下，任何人都可以在未经允许和付费的情况下复制其内容。

ex.s: But perhaps the most significant success that people have achieved to date is in medicine.
ex.t: 但也许人们在医学方面取得的最重大成就，是迄今为止的成就。

ex.s: What is your understanding of the line "Success is failure turned inside out"?
ex.t: 你对“成功是翻转过来的失败”这句话是怎么理解的？

ex.s: Passion alone does not ensure a person's success.
ex.t: 光有热情并不能保证一个人的成功。

ex.s: The giants’ success has benefited consumers.
ex.t: 这些巨头的成功惠及消费者。

ex.s: The book was an immediate success with children and adults, and has remained popular ever since.
ex.t: 这本书立即在儿童和成人中取得成功，并从此一直受欢迎。

ex.s: It has achieved notable success.
ex.t: 它已经取得了显著成功。

ex.s: It is important to know from the beginning that there are a lot of highs and lows, and there is no such thing as overnight success.”
ex.t: 重要的是从一开始就明白，其中有不少高潮与低谷，没有一夜成名这回事。

ex.s: Positive thinking and action result in success.
ex.t: 积极思维和行动带来成功。

defs.def: a person or thing that has achieved a good result and been successful 成功的人（或事物）

ex.s: disability cannot stop a man's pursuit of success
ex.t: D. 残疾无法阻挡一个人对成功的追求。

ex.s: The feeling of success was no longer attached to what grade I received but to the pure joy of learning.
ex.t: 成功的感觉不再与我所获得的分数挂钩，而是与学习的纯粹乐趣相连。

ex.s: Everyone is the maker of their own success.
ex.t: 每个人都是自己成功的创造者。

ex.s: Success favours those with a golden heart.
ex.t: 成功眷顾那些心地善良的人。

ex.s: A college holds the key to success.
ex.t: 大学掌握着成功的关键。

ex.s: Her strong desire for success.
ex.t: 她对成功的强烈渴望。

ex.s: It is a success story.
ex.t: 这是一个成功的案例。

ex.s: Education is the key to success.
ex.t: 教育是成功的关键。

ex.s: “This research also helps to prove that characteristics such as persistence -- which can be taught -- are key to a child’s life success.”
ex.t: “这项研究也有助于证明，像坚持这样的特质——是可以被教导的——是孩子人生成功的关键。”

ex.s: Success is not just about who can shout the loudest The world needs quieter people, too.
ex.t: 成功不仅仅关乎谁喊得最大声——这个世界也需要更安静的人。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

ex.s: My first step of redefining success began with course registrations.
ex.t: 我重新定义成功的第一步始于课程注册。

ex.s: her own understanding of successB. her desire for academic challenges
ex.t: 她对成功的理解B.她对学术挑战的渴望

ex.s: Every Saturday I begged Mom not to make me go to the swim meet, but had little chance of success.
ex.t: 每个星期六我都恳求妈妈不要让我去参加游泳比赛，但几乎不可能成功。

ex.s: England’s moment of success.
ex.t: 作为希望象征的英国国旗。
